_comment: English stopword set for DRE Search. PUT to Typesense as the 'dre_default' set by StopwordsSync (on every 'Reindex all corpora' and via the Maintenance 'Sync stopwords' action). QueryBuilder references it as `stopwords: dre_default` on every non-browse query, so common English function words ('the', 'of', 'and', …) don't dilute relevance. The site UI is English, so queries are expected in English; only the query is filtered, never the (multilingual) content.
_locale_note: locale 'en' matches how DRE indexes every field (Typesense's default pipeline, which folds diacritics to ASCII), so the set tokenizes the same way as the query stream.
_curation_note: A standard English stopword list (Snowball), trimmed of contraction fragments. Kept moderate — over-aggressive lists harm recall.
